title: fuzz_ws input
description: Input schema for the fuzz_ws tool (RFC-001 N8 typed WebSocket fuzzer).

flow_id.description: Recorded WebSocket stream id; when set, the upgrade dance inherits URL/headers/extensions from the recorded flow.

target_addr.description: Upstream host:port. Required when flow_id is empty.

scheme.description: WebSocket scheme. Required when flow_id is empty.

path.description: Upgrade request path. Required when flow_id is empty.

raw_query.description: Upgrade request raw query string without the leading '?'.

payload.description: Base frame payload interpreted per body_encoding; positions can target payload.

body_encoding.description: Encoding for base payload. Default text.

payload_set.description: Set true to send an empty base payload.

masked.description: Informational; layer auto-masks per RFC 6455 §5.3 regardless.

mask.description: Informational 4-byte mask key; ignored on Send.

close_code.description: RFC 6455 status code for Close frames.

close_reason.description: Base UTF-8 reason for Close frames; positions can target close_reason.

compressed.description: Per-message-deflate (RFC 7692); requires the upgrade to negotiate deflate via flow_id.

tag.description: Tag stored on every variant Stream's Tags map.

positions.description: Ordered position list. The cartesian product yields the variant sequence (capped at 1000).

stop_on_close.description: When true, abort the remaining variants once any variant receives a Close frame from upstream.

pre_macro.description: Pre macro hook executed before a variant's dial + upgrade (scope=iteration) or before the variant loop starts (scope=job). The hook macro shares the KV Store with the fuzz request so extracts flow into §var§ template expansion. For scope=job + on_error=skip, the whole job short-circuits with completed_variants=0 and stopped_reason set.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once outside the variant loop; KV Store is shared across the whole job).

on_error.description: skip (default; iteration scope skips the variant, job scope skips the whole job) | abort (aborts the whole fuzz run) | continue (record the error and proceed).

vars.description: Static kvStore overrides injected before the macro runs. For scope=iteration, injected into every variant's per-iteration kvStore after the job-store copy and before reserved-key seeding. For scope=job, injected once into the job kvStore at job start. Keys with the '__' reserved prefix are silently dropped at injection time so a Vars entry cannot shadow runtime-populated reserved keys (__iteration, __nonce, __response_*).

run_interval.description: Hook firing cadence — scope=iteration only. For pre_macro: always (default) | once | every_n | on_error. Rejected with an error when scope='job' (scope=job hooks fire exactly once by construction).

n.description: Iteration cadence for pre_macro run_interval='every_n'. Required when run_interval='every_n'.

status_codes.description: Response status codes gating post_macro run_interval='on_status'. pre_macro does NOT accept on_status — this field is rejected on pre_macro with a non-empty value. For fuzz_ws, status_code is sourced from the terminating frame's RFC 6455 close_code (0 when the terminating frame is not a Close frame).

match_pattern.description: Response body regex pattern for post_macro run_interval='on_match'. pre_macro does NOT accept on_match — this field is rejected on pre_macro with a non-empty value.

post_macro.description: Post macro hook executed after a variant's terminating frame (scope=iteration) or after the variant loop completes (scope=job). For scope=iteration, WS-specific reserved keys __response_opcode / __response_payload / __response_close_code / __response_close_reason are visible to the macro's template expansion. For scope=job, no per-iteration response is injected. Fires on natural exhaustion or stop_on_close exit, but NOT on ctx cancel.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once after the variant loop completes).

on_error.description: skip (default; log warn + record error row) | abort (post failures never abort the run; behaviour matches skip for post) | continue (same as skip).

vars.description: Static kvStore overrides injected before the macro runs. For scope=iteration, injected into every variant's per-iteration kvStore after the job-store copy and before reserved-key seeding. For scope=job, injected once into the job kvStore at job start. Keys with the '__' reserved prefix are silently dropped at injection time so a Vars entry cannot shadow runtime-populated reserved keys (__iteration, __nonce, __response_*).

run_interval.description: Hook firing cadence — scope=iteration only. For post_macro: always (default) | on_status | on_match. Rejected with an error when scope='job' (scope=job hooks fire exactly once by construction). For fuzz_ws, on_status matches against close_code (uint16); 0 in status_codes means 'no Close frame'.

n.description: Reserved for pre_macro run_interval='every_n'. post_macro does NOT accept every_n; supplying n on post_macro has no effect.

status_codes.description: Response status codes gating post_macro run_interval='on_status'. For fuzz_ws, this matches the terminating frame's close_code; include 0 to match variants where the terminating frame is not a Close frame.

match_pattern.description: Response body regex pattern for post_macro run_interval='on_match'. For fuzz_ws this matches against the close_reason text (no body equivalent for WebSocket frames in the macro path).
